set.body:
Journey 3 of docs/plan.md.

Done when
A steward shares one release, or a subset, with a named person in another lab. The recipient finds it on Home and downloads it. The steward sees everyone with access and why, and revokes it. SHARE5 is the acceptance rehearsal.

What exists
The engine is strongest here: grants to an exact release or to a study as it grows, expiry, revocation checked at the moment of use, explanations of why access holds, and a people directory by name. The server already lists grants and recipients.

What is wrong today
The Access screen is an operator form. People can be searched by name, but the form still shows and validates a principal UUID, lists only the grants made in this browser session, and revokes by grant identifier. The API accepts the Discover permission and Home already lists shares, but the console's form does not offer it, so a share made in the browser never appears on the recipient's Home. There is no way to download a whole release over HTTP.

Order
SHARE1 follows the design in SEE1. SHARE2 is independent engine work and also serves OPEN2. SHARE3 builds on SHARE1. SHARE5 closes the journey.
set.title: SHARE: Share a release between labs and take it back
